title: types/plugin-form: objectstack now judges an object-master-detail-form `details` entry as a strict shape — the parity row and mirror follow at the next spec bump; the spec's `sortField` follows #11376 at the next pin bump
body:
Filing gate: **④ a coordination child**, filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` seat 1 (`session_01UtnxvdiN376GF3sgXwAw4d`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6017) for objectstack-ai/objectstack#20928, whose triage direction says "the `MasterDetailForm` mirror follows at the pin bump. This claim files that coordination child". The precedent is objectui#11266 for objectstack-ai/objectstack#20901. ⛔ Not a claim. Reader: objectui triage first, then the `domain:ui` seat; the spec half (below) is read by whoever bumps objectstack's `.objectui-sha`.

## What changed upstream

objectstack PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21215 landed as `a29a0ea555` (`@objectstack/spec` `minor`, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, ADR-0087 D3 entry `ui-object-master-detail-form-details-closed`). It ships in the next `@objectstack/spec` release; at filing no published version carries it.
- `ComponentPropsMap['object-master-detail-form'].details` changed from `z.array(z.unknown())` to an array of strict entries with twelve keys: `childObject` (required), `relationshipField`, `columns`, `formFields`, `inlineMode`, `amountField`, `sortField`, `totalField`, `title`, `minRows`, `maxRows`, `addLabel`. Those are the members of `MasterDetailDetailConfig` at the pin `31971ff1e28f`.
- `details[].columns` references `InlineGridColumnSchema` by identity, the same column `subforms[].columns` and `inlineColumns` take. `defineStack`'s cross-reference check reaches the block on any page.
- A new type `ObjectMasterDetailFormPropsParsed` is exported, because input and output now differ.

## Sites here (objectui `origin/main` `d59f11c0d`)

1. **The console parity row.** `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts:2912`, `'object-master-detail-form.details'`. Its `pins` prose says "The spec row is `z.array(z.unknown())` … so the read site is the whole member contract". That is false once the spec bump lands, so the row is rewritten against the strict entry.
2. **The types mirror.** `packages/types` imports `ObjectMasterDetailFormPropsSchema` by reference (`src/__tests__/imported-defaults-8317.test.ts:87`, `src/__tests__/registered-type-arms-10859-b2.test.ts:45`). The objectstack dev and review read the non-test importer path as taking the schema through `stripImportedDefaults`. Whether objectui's suites stay green against the new spec is NOT MEASURED, so run them at the bump.
3. **`sortField`, the other direction.** objectui `main` retired `MasterDetailDetailConfig.sortField` at `0a3e5409f` (#11376, #11070 round 9), after the pin `31971ff1e28f` objectstack measured against. So objectstack's new entry DECLARES `sortField`, which objectui `main` no longer reads. The objectstack pin bump that crosses `0a3e5409f` owes the spec half in the same landing: retire `sortField` from the detail entry (a tombstone naming the derived sort, plus an ADR-0087 entry), or the spec accepts a key nothing reads. #11376's own census counted objectstack `sortField` writers as 0, before objectstack-ai/objectstack#21215 added the declaration.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

At the next `@objectstack/spec` bump that carries `a29a0ea555`, objectui's mirror and the parity row follow the strict entry (reference the spec's shape rather than restating it). At the next objectstack pin bump past `0a3e5409f`, objectstack retires `sortField` from the entry. That half is objectstack's and is recorded on objectstack's seat post #6017.

## Dedupe

All 70 open objectui issues, listed over REST (`open_issues_count` 72 = 70 issues + 2 open PRs, so the enumeration is complete) and grepped locally: `object-master-detail-form` together with `details`: 0 hits; `MasterDetailDetailConfig`: 0 hits. Control: `subforms` answers 3 hits in the same corpus, #11266 (the `subforms[].columns` sibling, a different carrier) among them.
